thread:
alex: quick heads-up — PR #432 (docs): added private-deployment migration guide. Vercel preview is returning 404s for CSS/assets: https://vercel.app/preview/pr-432 — GH Actions shows 'asset not found' in the build log

priya: can you paste the vercel log snippet? i saw a failed run earlier, looked like pathing to /assets/styles.css

lauren: probable base-path mismatch. our mkdocs.yml currently has an absolute site_url set to the production domain. on ephemeral previews that breaks relative asset links. quick workaround is to make URLs relative or clear site_url for preview builds

docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://vercel.app/preview/pr-432 (status: failed) — logs: `Could not resolve ../assets/styles.css`

mike: yep. easiest repro locally: `mkdocs build -d site && python -m http.server 8000 -d site` then open http://localhost:8000 and check network. also try toggling `use_directory_urls` in mkdocs.yml.

alex: thanks — i can repro locally. noted the site_url was set. i'll push a quick change to remove site_url and compress the large PNGs we included. also @lauren @mike — can you review? want to merge by EOD if preview looks clean

lauren: on it. doing a quick pass. small copy nits in the migration steps, and one example uses old SDK snippet (needs update to new client import)

priya: FYI GH Actions job `docs-preview` was timing out in the image optimization step on our runners. reducing image count or switching to webp helped in my last fix; ping me if you want me to handle conversions

alex: pushed: remove site_url, compressed images, updated SDK snippet to `from redwood import RedwoodClient` example. also added a short local preview note: `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` and `mkdocs build -d site && python -m http.server 8000 -d site`

deploy-bot: deploy-preview updated: https://vercel.app/preview/pr-432 (status: success) — artifacts served

lauren: preview looks good now. assets load and the updated SDK snippet renders. one nit: replace `--env` flag example with `REDACTED` placeholder for secrets

mike: LGTM after the nit. if CI stays green i'm happy to merge.

alex: CI currently running the full suite. will wait for green then merge. thanks for quick turnaround y'all

mike: CI passed for all checks. merging now.

alex: merged — thanks everyone :tada: 

lauren: nice, thanks for shepherding this. added a DOCS-RELEASE note for the change

priya: great! saved me a future debugging session :grin:
